text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our three-legged race as trainer and 
trainee alongside Cheval Grand was finally 
beginning in earnest—and yet...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being introverted, she feels an 
inferiority complex toward the lively 
nature of her highly praised sisters and 
peers in the middle-to-long-distance 
division.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she also harbors a grand 
ambition... To become the world's number 
one, "greatest Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined to keep supporting the timid 
girl as she aimed for a glorious goal, the 
challenge in the Twinkle Series began.
